  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `main()` collects `test_` globals without filtering for callables.
  WHY: A future non-callable symbol like `test_cases = [...]` would raise `TypeError` when the runner tries to invoke it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:104-109 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The zero-candidate guard treats an empty or non-numeric `total` as an arithmetic error instead of a clean `exit 0`.
  WHY: Severity was reported as MAJOR by x-ai_grok-4_20 and NIT by qwen_qwen3_6-plus; a bad `jq` result aborts the fast-exit path and can force the full sweep flow.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3660-3695 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The scope-blocked latch verification uses `gh issue view` plus `grep -qxF` without distinguishing transient API failures from a missing label.
  WHY: A temporary empty/error response can be misreported as “FAILED to latch,” causing a false negative and unnecessary manual retry.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3044-3052 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The single-fetch cancel-on-close loop no longer distinguishes network failure from a completed run after capturing `EXISTING_RUN_JSON`.
  WHY: The lost error handling can make the loop spin or exit with confusing state on transient API failures.
- analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md:708,714,733,746,765 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The report still says implemented safe-subset items are “Intentionally deferred” or “under analysis” and claims “no additional runtime change” despite the PR changing runtime workflows and deleting the old docs.
  WHY: The closeout ledger no longer matches the code and will mislead maintainers about what shipped versus what was deferred.
- tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py:19,34 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The file uses tabs for indentation, so it trips Ruff E111 before any assertions run.
  WHY: The reviewer says `python3 tests/test_ci_inventory_parity_order_contract.py` fails with `E111 indentation is not a multiple of 4`, so the test cannot execute.
- tests/test_review_autofix_sweep_zero_candidate_fast_exit.py:entire file | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The file uses tabs for indentation, so it trips Ruff E111 before any assertions run.
  WHY: The reviewer says the same indentation problem applies throughout the sweep test file, so the test cannot execute.
